tools.name: get_blog_post
tools.description: Returns one published AIO Mapper article by its exact slug, including metadata and bounded Markdown content. It cannot fetch arbitrary URLs or private pages.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Finds published AIO Mapper FAQ answers about audits, AI readiness, live AI visibility, Research, Tracking, Brand perception, plans, credits, and account controls.

question.description: The product question to match against AIO Mapper's published FAQs.

tools.name: get_pricing_plans
tools.description: Returns current AIO Mapper Free, Pro, and one-time credit-pack prices, allowances, refresh behavior, and feature boundaries in Canadian dollars.

tools.name: get_scoring_methodology
tools.description: Returns the current SEO Score and AI Readiness Score methodology, applicable components, interpretation rules, and the distinction from live AI visibility tracking.

tools.name: list_blog_posts
tools.description: Lists published AIO Mapper guides with titles, descriptions, dates, tags, authors, and canonical URLs. An optional topic filters titles, descriptions, and tags.

tools.name: prepare_audit
tools.description: Validates and prefills a public page URL in AIO Mapper's audit screen. This only navigates and prepares the form: it never runs an audit, consumes a credit, or bypasses user confirmation.

url.description: The public http or https webpage URL to prefill.

navigate.description: Whether to open the prefilled audit screen. Defaults to true.
